dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #You've come at long last, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: While I was waiting for you, I nearly finished penning quite a few poems.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It's great, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I know that every detail here is the result of your hard work. I hold immense gratitude for all you've done.

choices.text: If you like it, I'm happy.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Yes, I love it!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oh, I'm flattered that you asked for my thoughts.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But you should be more confident in your own tastes!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Here, you're the real-deal protagonist!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Try things with confidence and turn your ideas into reality. And if you ever run into trouble, I'll lend a helping hand!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: This place already has everything I want!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Okay! Ahem... My dearest companion, is there something you wish to tell me?

choices.text: Actually, I've been pretty tired lately...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hee-hee... My warrior, you've worked so hard.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I understand how you feel.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: ...When you just can't find any more energy, and the world falls into a haze — even apples lose their sweet flavor.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: If you can get some quality shut-eye at this time, you'll feel a lot better when you wake up.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Here, I'll lend you my shoulder.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Eh-hehe...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: At any rate, don't worry.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Whenever you need me, I'll always be by your side.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Many people may feel lost at times. After all, it's impossible for everything to happen according to your own wishes.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: At a time like this, ask yourself what the most important thing is!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Even if life's all in a jumble, you can sort it out as long as there's a whisper of the wind.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: ...Don't be afraid, I'm here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Your serious face... is a rare sight.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm... *gasp* Let's hold a feast!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Call up your good friends and I'll contribute a bottle of the finest wine from my collection!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: As for the location...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Let's just have it here! We can find a clear space and decorate it with benches, a porch, and beautiful fresh flowers!

choices.text: So... what's the theme of our celebration?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Uh, we need a theme? Then hold on, lemme think of one.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Uh... "Cheers!" Eh... "Pop!" No... I got it! "Wishes for Happiness"? How's that?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oh, yeah! Can I trouble you to prepare one of your specialty dishes?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Anything's fine — I like to eat any dish you make!

choices.text: Heh, sounds like it'll be quite a merry time.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oh, yeah~ It'll definitely be lively.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Alright, then let us officially start the preparations!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: What a joyous day... It calls for a drink to celebrate.

choices.text: Hmm... I feel like it'll be chaotic.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hee-hee, making cheer from chaos is a staple of feasts!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Don't worry, I'll properly organize it.

choices.text: Will you put on a show for us?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Sure! I'll sing along to a suite I haven't played in a long time.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Any songs you wanna hear? I can practice a bit beforehand. Of course, this won't take up much time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Venti.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Going anywhere to play today? There are a lot of places I wanna visit — need a recommendation?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Venti.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #Aw, I don't want to sleep yet, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Wanna keep me company a bit longer? Or... I'll keep you company?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah... the park is one of the most pleasant places in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Most people taking a break there are relaxed and in pretty good spirits, so they're always willing to listen to a song or two.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Eh-he~ let's work together to make this park even more beautiful!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Whoa! This orchard smells wonderful! The apples must be super big and juicy!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: And these bunches of grapes weighing down the dense vines... *sigh* They'll become delicious wine one day...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Why don't we... sample some of these future wines? Hehe, it can't hurt to enjoy them a little. Come on, open wide~
